summary: Iteration 11: Tested Phase 3 (Dynamic findings sync), Phase 4 (AI-enhanced report with 5 sections), Phase 5 (Audit closure UI). All 24 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified with all required elements present.
passed_tests: Phase 3 - Dynamic Findings Sync:
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id}/checklist/{item_id} with result=no_cumple auto-creates finding with source_item_id
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id}/checklist/{item_id} changing from no_cumple to cumple auto-resolves finding (status=resolved_by_compliance)
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id}/checklist/{item_id} changing from cumple back to no_cumple re-opens finding with change_log
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id}/checklist/{item_id} with result=parcial creates observation finding
Findings have change_log array tracking all result changes with from/to/by/at
Phase 4 - AI-Enhanced Report:
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id}/ai-redaction saves ai_redacted_strengths
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id}/ai-redaction saves ai_redacted_findings
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id}/ai-redaction saves ai_redacted_recommendations
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id}/ai-redaction saves ai_redacted_conclusions
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id}/ai-redaction saves multiple fields at once
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id}/ai-redaction rejects unknown fields (400)
POST /api/audits/ai/assist with type=strengths returns AI text
POST /api/audits/ai/assist with type=recommendations returns AI text
POST /api/audits/ai/assist with type=conclusions returns AI text
POST /api/audits/ai/assist with type=findings_report returns AI text
Phase 5 - Audit Closure:
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id} with status=closed validates end_date (400 if missing)
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id} with status=closed validates end_time (400 if missing)
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id} with status=closed validates auditor (400 if missing)
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id} with status=closed validates copasst_member.name (400 if missing)
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id} with status=closed succeeds with all required fields
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id} with status=reviewed also enforces business rules
Frontend Consolidado Tab:
Score card with PHVA breakdown (PLANEAR, HACER, VERIFICAR, ACTUAR) visible
5 AI sections present: Resumen Ejecutivo, Fortalezas Identificadas, Hallazgos, Recomendaciones, Conclusiones
5 'Mejorar con IA' buttons present for each section
Audit info card showing Auditor Lider and Miembro COPASST
Closure panel with Fecha de Cierre and Hora de Cierre inputs
'Cerrar Auditoria' button present and functional
Closure panel hidden when audit status is closed (shows 'Auditoria Cerrada' badge instead)
critical_code_review_comments: Legacy findings (created before Phase 3) don't have change_log field - this is expected but may need migration if historical tracking is required
AI assist endpoint uses GPT-5.2 via Emergent LLM integration - working correctly
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_Closure_Panel_Test audit during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3, 4, 5 fully tested and working. Dynamic findings sync: checklist changes auto-create/update/resolve findings with change_log tracking. AI-enhanced report: 5 sections (summary, strengths, findings, recommendations, conclusions) with 'Mejorar con IA' buttons. Closure UI: validates auditor, end_date, end_time, copasst_member.name before allowing status=closed or status=reviewed. Closure panel hidden when audit is closed.

phase5_closure_validation.ui_behavior: Closure panel hidden when audit.status is 'closed' or 'reviewed'
